generations.text: Marco Natarajan contacted support because the Nimbus Hub reboots during updates since 2026-05-07. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently Escalated. The agent offered a credit of $49.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-72005 and asked for a replacement. The knowledge base notes that Strata Mini rear-tray jams clear with the 3-step reset. The customer was told a firmware update would arrive on 2026-06-10.
